name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Implementation Manager role. Taking a documented design, understanding the business reason behind it, and turning it into configuration people can actually work in is what I do every day. In my own practice I configure CRM and automation platforms from client requirements, prepare and validate the data imports myself, test the workflows before launch, and train the team that will use them.

I've also run implementations at volume. At Wix I managed up to about 25 concurrent onboardings and launched 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets. At Accelo I built sequenced implementation plans for a CRM and PSA platform and walked professional-services clients through its invoicing and billing workflows. When something didn't match the plan, I escalated it early rather than letting it turn into rework, and I'd bring that same habit to knowing when Solution Architecture needs to come back in.

I haven't worked in CPG or trade promotion, and I'd be learning deductions from the ground up. I've built e-commerce for retail brands and I work in Excel and data every day, and I'd welcome a conversation.
